account.createDescription: Create an account to track its balance and transactions. You can add more payment methods or edit details later in Settings.
account.editDescription: Update the details for this account.
account.displayNamePlaceholder: e.g., Bank Account, Cash Wallet, Credit Card
account.assetTooltipText: Money you own (e.g., savings bank account).
account.savingsAccountTooltip: Balances from savings accounts are used to calculate your total savings and goals.
account.excludeFromNetWorthTooltip: If checked, this account's balance won't count toward your total net worth.
account.openingBalanceTooltip: The initial amount of money in this account when you start tracking.
account.title: Accounts
account.tooltip: Accounts are the core of Moniq. They represent places where your money lives (like Bank Accounts or Wallets) or money you owe (like Credit Cards or Loans). Every transaction requires an account. You should create an account for each place where your money lives or where you owe money like individual bank accounts, individual credit cards etc.

category.title: Categories
category.tooltip: Categories organize your income and expenses into a hierarchy. Drag to reorder within groups.
category.subtitle: Expense & Income Classification
category.createDescription: Create a category to group your transactions. You can manage and edit categories later in Settings.
category.editDescription: Update the details for this category.
category.head: Head (Main Category)

method.title: Payment Methods
method.tooltip: Payment Methods represent how you pay — like UPI, Credit Card, or Cash. When you add a transaction, selecting a method auto-fills the linked account. A default method is created automatically for every new account. Drag to reorder.
method.archiveTooltip: Archive to hide this method from new transactions without losing history.
method.deleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to permanently delete this payment method? This cannot be undone.
